title: Determining Half-Lives of Oligomeric Proteins by Cycloheximide Blocking and Non-Dissociating Western Blot
author: Contreras-Treviño I
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iiwccfe
materials: Scraping cells in 1 mL of cold PBS. Centrifuge at 13.200 g for 10 minutes at 4 ° C. Cell pellet (1.25 x 10 5 cells) is resuspended in 20 ul of lysis buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 5 mM MgCl 2 , 0.4 U / mL DNase I, 0.01 mg / mL RNase A and Complete® protease inhibitor [Roche]). Incubate during 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Seed BSC‑1 cells
steps.instruction: Plate 5 × 10⁵ BSC‑1 cells per well in 6‑well plates using 3 ml MEM‑7.5 % FBS; incubate 12–24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until confluent.

steps.title: Infect with recombinant vaccinia
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml MEM‑2.5 % FBS containing vaccinia virus (MOI = 10) to each well; adsorb 2 h while swirling gently every 30 min; aspirate inoculum and add 0.4 mM IPTG in MEM‑2.5 % FBS; incubate 12 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Treat with cycloheximide and MG132
steps.instruction: Aspirate medium, wash twice with MEM‑2.5 % FBS, then add 2 ml MEM‑2.5 % SFB containing 100 µg/ml cycloheximide and either 0.5 µM MG132 or DMSO. Prepare MG132 stock at 6.25 mM in DMSO and dilute 1:100 in MEM before addition. Incubate for the indicated times (0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4 h).

steps.title: Lyse cells in Laemmli buffer
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl non‑dissociating 2× Laemmli buffer (62.5 mM Tris‑HCl pH 6.8, 20 % glycerol, 0.8 % SDS) to each well; incubate 30 min on ice.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Load samples onto a 12 % SDS‑PAGE gel (0.75 mm thickness) prepared in 16 × 18 cm plates; run in a cold room at 4 mA for 16 h; reserve one lane for molecular‑weight markers.

steps.title: Transfer to PVDF membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins to PVDF membranes for 2 h using a semidry system and dissociating transfer buffer (25 mM Tris, 192 mM glycine, 0.1 % SDS, 20 % v/v methanol).

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Block PVDF membrane in 5 % non‑fat dry milk prepared in TBS.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate membrane overnight at 4 °C with rat anti‑NSP3 diluted 1:20,000 in 1 % non‑fat dry milk, 0.05 % Tween‑20 in TBS.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate membrane 2 h at room temperature with HRP‑conjugated anti‑rat IgG diluted 1:20,000 in 1 % non‑fat dry milk, 0.05 % Tween‑20 in TBS.

steps.title: Develop and analyze blot
steps.instruction: Develop blots with SuperSignal West Femto chemiluminescence substrate according to the manufacturer (Pierce, Rockford, IL); acquire images and perform densitometry using ImageJ software.
